primary_risk: User impersonation via public endpoint could lead to unauthorized access and data breaches.
likely_attack_path: Attacker intercepts authentication requests, analyzes token structure, and creates forged tokens to impersonate legitimate users.
security_signals: Unusual authentication patterns detected by AWS WAF
Multiple failed login attempts from a single IP
Suspicious token validation failures in CloudTrail logs
hidden_truth_candidates: Insufficient token validation mechanisms in place
architecture_summary: AWS IAM architecture with user authentication through IAM Identity Center, role management, and monitoring using CloudTrail and CloudWatch.
